data: What is the maximum value of the Entity F1 score for MANN+MD when the memory size is 4000 CamRest dataset?

The question asks for the maximum value of the Entity F1 score for MANN+MD when the memory size is 4000 CamRest dataset. From the caption, we know that higher values are preferred. From the figure, we can see that the green line represents MANN+MD. The green line reaches its highest point at approximately 80 on the y-axis when the memory size is 4000. Therefore, the maximum value of the Entity F1 score for MANN+MD when the memory size is 4000 CamRest dataset is around 80.
